scope: Single-adapter live public display queries only. Five factory/device/chain routes share Win32 current-mode data; buffer dimensions remain resource descriptors. Preserve existing D3D9 fallback to 1024x768 X8R8G8B8/60 and unknown-refresh normalization to 60. Additional chains are queried through their own objects; device ordinals and GetNumberOfSwapChains cover implicit chains. No new rendering/pixel run; inherit accepted 4H6f4a/4H6c GPU evidence. D3D8 mode integration, full mode normalization, adapter groups, physical device loss, concurrent publication, native HAL and game/FPS remain outside this step.

documentation.fact: The query returns the adapter display mode, including when the device does not own fullscreen mode.
Only swap chains implicitly created by CreateDevice are counted.
